row: This is the NC State official Veterinary Professions Advising Center (VetPAC) channel. VetPAC is a unique undergraduate preveterinary advising center at North Carolina State University. The goal of VetPAC is to provide NC State students and alumni with the resources, guidance, and experiences necessary to become competitive veterinary school applicants. Learn more at https://cals.ncsu.edu/vetpac/
